preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Each string in the test cases has at least 2 characters.
The length of each string does not exceed 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(q >= 1 and q <= 2 * 10**5 for q in test_cases_queries)
preconditions.description: The number of queries per test case is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l < r <= len(s) for s, queries in test_cases_queries for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query has valid indices l and r where 1 ≤ l < r ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all((r - l + 1) % 2 == 0 for s, queries in test_cases_queries for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query substring has an even length.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()[]' for s in test_cases for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each string consists only of round and square brackets.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == q for output, q in zip(test_case_outputs, test_cases_queries))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per query.

postconditions.expression: all(x >= 0 for output in test_case_outputs for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_bracket_sequence(transformed_substring) for s, queries, output in zip(test_cases, test_cases_queries, test_case_outputs) for (l, r), x in zip(queries, output) for transformed_substring in possible_transformations(s[l-1:r], x))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output x is the minimum cost to transform the substring s[l..r] into a valid bracket sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(min_cost(s[l-1:r]) == x for s, queries, output in zip(test_cases, test_cases_queries, test_case_outputs) for (l, r), x in zip(queries, output))
postconditions.description: The output x for each query is the minimum cost to make the substring s[l..r] a correct bracket sequence.
